messages:
maya: Heads-up — ran into a permission mismatch in staging. Scoped API tokens are losing the actor/principal when requests are routed through the edge -> dedicated pool path. Telemetry shows the call as coming from `service-account/gateway` not the original user token.
ryan: Oof. Do we have an example request/headers? Is this the X-Principal header drop we saw last year?
maya: Yup, reproducible. quick curl: 
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer tok.sandbox' -H 'X-Principal: user:alice;scopes=routes:read' https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate
```
At the backend (dedicated pool) log: `principal=null, proxy=service-account/gateway` so our effective-scopes UI shows the service scope instead of alice's.
olga: That lines up — gateway strips unknown headers before proxying to the pool for security. We did that to avoid header injection but forgot to re-propagate a sanitized principal blob.
sam: From a product side: this breaks two things — 1) console "effective permissions" reports, 2) audit trails for enterprise tenants. We should treat principal propagation like a first-class, signed header.
hugo: UI thought — we could add an "Effective principal (inferred)" badge in the permissions panel and show when the principal is proxied vs direct. But only if the data is trustworthy.
anya-product: Enterprise customers will want tamper-proof evidence in logs. Can we add signature or HMAC on the header so dedicated pools can verify gateway set it? Also need a rollout plan so we don't surface wrong info mid-beta.
olga: Technical plan idea: gateway signs a compact JSON principal payload and sets `X-Principal-Signed` + `X-Principal-Sig`. Pools verify sig against gateway cert. If verification fails, mark as proxied-unknown. Simple proto: 
```
{"id":"user:alice","scopes":["routes:read"],"issued_by":"gateway-1","iat":1680000000}
```
then HMAC with gateway key.
ryan: Telemetry change needed — when signature present, emit metric `auth.principal.verified=1` and record `effective_principal_id` in trace. That lets Console query traces for the real actor. I'll own the metric.
maya: Sounds good. Edge case: what about delegated tokens? e.g., service A holds a scoped token that itself was issued by B on behalf of user. We need to preserve chain.
olga: We can embed `chain: [ {type:service, id:svc-a}, {type:user, id:user:alice} ]` in the signed payload. Pools will compute effective scope = union(chain scopes) or intersection depending on policy (we should decide).
sam: Policy decision: default to intersection for safety (token delegation shouldn't expand rights). Product can expose an "allow delegation widening" flag per tenant.
hugo: For UI: show chain as collapsible rows: service -> user, and show how final effective-scopes computed (intersection or override). Mockup incoming.
anya-product: Rollout: 1) gateway implements signing, 2) pool verifies and surfaces `verified` flag, 3) console adds UI (hidden behind feature flag), 4) telemetry collects metrics + audit logs. Canary to 10% tenants first.
infra-bot: Deploy plan created: #deploy 2026-04-02 gateway-signed-principal -> canary 10% -> monitor auth.principal.verified > 95% -> promote. (CI link: https://ci.redwood.test/1234)
ryan: Owners: olga (gateway + pool verification), hugo (console UI), ryan (telemetry/traces), sam (policy + product flags). Timeline: 2 sprints for core, UI in sprint 3.
maya: Thanks — I'll add a minimal repro & logs to the ticket. Also flagged related: quota enforcement currently uses proxied identity, so must not double-count.
olga: Noted. We'll also add a check to ensure quota lookups use `effective_principal_id` when verified.
hugo: I'll attach mock screenshots to the ticket and include the feature-flag toggle.
maya: :thumbsup: also adding a short note for support about how reported "effective perms" might change after rollout.
anya-product: Agreed, add to release notes + enterprise migration doc.
ryan: I'll wire an alert if `auth.principal.verified` < 80% during canary.
maya: Great. Thanks team — next step: PRs.
infra-bot: PRs linked: https://git.redwood/test/gateway/pull/789, https://git.redwood/test/pool/pull/456, https://git.redwood/test/console/pull/321
sam: :white_check_mark:
